description: This file defines the MqttCommandEndpointConfiguration class, which extends CommandEndpointConfiguration, providing configuration properties for MQTT command endpoints used in tests. It includes methods for generating specific MQTT topic strings used in command and response messaging, and for asserting the structure of command topics.

classes.name: MqttCommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for MQTT command endpoints in testing scenarios, managing topic filters and related properties.

methods.name: getCommandTopicFilter
methods.description: Returns the MQTT topic filter string based on the subscriber role and legacy topic filter flag, optionally including a device ID.

methods.name: getResponseTopic
methods.description: Generates the MQTT topic string used for publishing device responses to commands, incorporating device ID, request ID, and status code.

methods.name: assertCommandPublishTopicStructure
methods.description: Asserts that a given ResourceIdentifier representing a command publish topic has the expected structure based on configuration and parameters.
